oma_core.fair_play.lan_cheats_revoked: Grandma's house rules: this world was created without cheats, so opening it to LAN does not turn cheats on.
oma_core.fair_play.value_reset: Grandma's house rules: the setting %s is fixed in worlds without cheats and was put back.
oma_core.rejoin.home: Grandma waved you home. Wipe your feet!
oma_core.rejoin.home_with_return: Grandma waved you home. When you are ready, /oma work return takes you back to where you left off.
oma_core.work.returned: Back to work! Grandma's cookie still needs a good deal of industrial excellence.
oma_core.work.none: There is no saved work place yet. Grandma says: go out and make one!
oma_core.work.used: You already used the way back on this visit. It is available again after your next login.
oma_core.work.unsafe: Your old work place is not safe right now (blocked, lava, or outside the world border). Better walk there yourself.
oma_core.house.missing: This world has no Grandma's house yet. An operator can build it with /oma house place.
oma_core.house.info: Grandma's house: origin %s, arrival %s, Grandma's spot %s
oma_core.house.overworld_only: Grandma's house can only be built in the Overworld.
oma_core.house.placed: Grandma's house built at %s. The world spawn is now inside it.
oma_core.grandma.ok: Grandma is at her spot (%s). Everything is fine.
oma_core.grandma.spawned: Grandma has been called to her spot (%s).
oma_core.grandma.not_loaded: Grandma's house is not loaded right now; nothing was changed.
oma_core.grandma.limit: Grandma went missing several times within 10 minutes; automatic restoring is paused. Use /oma repair.
oma_core.grandma.failed: Grandma could not be created. See the server log.
text.oma_core.grandma.greeting: Oh, there you are, @initiator! Coffee is ready. Do you know what's missing? A cookie. MY cookie, Grandpa's favourite. In 1987 the Cookie Authority threw it out of the village fair for "missing certificates". This time it gets every certificate there is! Here is my recipe book. Bake it by the book and bring it to me.
oma_core.grandma.spawning: Grandma is on her way to her spot. Check again in a few seconds.
item.oma_core.recipe_book.lore: Slightly more than a recipe. Slightly.
oma_core.grandma.book_given: Grandma hands you her recipe book: "Do not get flour on it!"
oma_core.grandma.book_already: Grandma: "You already have my recipe book, dear. It is in your pocket!"
oma_core.grandma.book_missing_mod: Grandma cannot find her recipe book (FTB Quests is missing).
oma_core.cookie.accepted: %s handed Grandma THE cookie! She dunks it in her coffee and smiles: "Now THAT is a cookie."
oma_core.cookie.already: Grandma already has her cookie from your team. "One is plenty, dear... for now."
oma_core.cookie.vanilla: Grandma looks at the cookie and sighs: "That is a cookie, dear. But it is not MY cookie."
oma_core.cookie.none: Grandma: "No cookie yet? The recipe book will help you, dear. When it is done, just hand it to me."
text.oma_core.grandma.working: Ah, @initiator! Is my cookie in the oven yet? Stick to my recipe book, step by step. Grandma notices shortcuts.
text.oma_core.grandma.thanks: Oh my... it smells just like Sunday afternoons with Grandpa. *dunk* Thank you, @initiator! Let Inspector Crumble look for a missing certificate now. THAT is a cookie.
text.oma_core.grandma.delivered: @initiator, dear! That cookie was perfect. Grandma still dreams of it... Grandpa would have loved it too. Who knows, maybe one day you will bake one for him.
text.oma_core.grandma.vanilla: That is a cookie, dear. But it is not MY cookie. Did you even open my recipe book?
oma_core.grandma.book_spare: Grandma sighs and hands you a spare copy of her recipe book.
book.oma_core.recipe_note.page1:
GRANDMA'S COOKIE

- flour, PROPER flour
- fine sugar
- butter from a happy cow
- tempered chocolate
- real vanilla
- a pinch of salt
- love (cannot be certified)
book.oma_core.recipe_note.page2:
Bake until golden. Not brown. GOLDEN.

Grandpa's favourite.

P.S. In 1987 Inspector Crumble threw this cookie out of the fair: "missing certificates". This time we do everything by the book. HIS book.
book.oma_core.work_permit_a1.page1:
COOKIE AUTHORITY
Work Permit A1

The bearer may collect raw materials, operate simple machines and annoy the neighbours within reason.

Valid until the cookie is done.
book.oma_core.work_permit_a1.page2:
Stamp: APPROVED

Issued by: Grandma, from her shoebox of blank forms (since 1987).

Inspector Crumble will hear about it. Eventually.
oma_core.drawer.placed: Grandma's drawer was put back at %s.
oma_core.drawer.stuck: The drawer won't budge. Its handle broke in 1987 and only hangs there for show. Grandma: "You'll need a new handle, dear. Planks and two sticks."
oma_core.drawer.opened: *creak* With the new handle the drawer opens for the first time since 1987. Inside: a yellowed letter and a single, suspiciously perfect factory cookie.
oma_core.drawer.empty: The drawer is empty, apart from crumbs from 1987.
oma_core.drawer.restock: Grandma bought a whole pack back then, "to know the enemy". There is another Crumblix cookie in the drawer.
book.oma_core.notice_1987.page1:
COOKIE AUTHORITY
Notice No. 1987/042

Re: Golden Cookie, village fair

The entry "Grandma's Cookie" is DISQUALIFIED.

Reason: missing certificates (all of them).
book.oma_core.notice_1987.page2:
The Golden Cookie goes to the Crumblix factory cookie: fully certified.

Taste is not a certificate.

Inspector Crumble

[Grandma's handwriting:]
Just you wait.
item.oma_core.crumblix_cookie.lore: Golden Cookie winner 1987. Fully certified. Best before: 1988.
book.oma_core.cookie_regulation.page1:
COOKIE REGULATION
(excerpt)

Art. 1 A cookie is only a cookie with a certificate.
Art. 2 Every ingredient needs its own certificate.
Art. 3 Every certificate needs a stamp.
book.oma_core.cookie_regulation.page2:
Art. 4 Transport only through approved, documented pipes.
Art. 5 Shortcuts are forbidden. Especially tasty ones.
Art. 6 The Inspector may add articles at any time.

Inspector Crumble
text.oma_core.grandma.working_2: Inspector Crumble wrote again. Apparently "flour" is now called "certified flour". Grandpa would have laughed himself silly.
text.oma_core.grandma.working_3: I have kept every Cookie Authority form since 1987, dear. In a shoebox. Alphabetically. You never know.
text.oma_core.grandma.working_4: Grandpa always said: a good cookie needs time, butter and a proper paper trail.
text.oma_core.grandma.working_5: Coffee? It's fresh. Well, fresh enough. The spoon still stands up in it, so it's fine.
text.oma_core.grandma.working_6: Crumblix won in 1987 with a factory cookie. If they want a factory, they shall have a factory, dear. With MY recipe.
text.oma_core.grandma.vanilla_2: Looks like a Crumblix to me. Certified cardboard, dear. That is exactly what won in 1987. Put it away before I get upset.
oma_core.house.protected: Hands off, dear! Grandma's house stays the way it is.

oma_core.credits.not_yet: The credits unlock once your team has brought Grandma the cookie.
oma_core.credits.card.title: Grandma's Cookie
